'''Kuimi Enissa''' was a [[human]] [[pirate]]. A former [[Lieutenant (criminal)|lieutenant]] of the [[Lumini pirates]], Enissa was the sole survivor of an attack by the [[First Order]]. While she was unable to fully process the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]], callously disregarding the New Republic's fate as deserved, the First Order's crackdown on [[Kijimi]] closely affected her.<ref name="TROS VD" /> In [[35 ABY]], she attended the [[Resistance]] celebrations on the [[jungle]] [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]] and was stood behind [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Landonis Calrissian]] and [[Jannah]] when they first met.<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref>
